bill.title: Home-Based Business Fairness Act.

posted_text:
🏗️ Housing
NC HB 372 — NC Cities Can't Stop Your Home Biz (Mostly)

North Carolina cities can't ban no-impact home-based businesses or require permits for them. They *can* regulate these businesses to protect public health and safety, ensuring they're compatible with the neighborhood and don't violate state or federal laws. .. .... ..
